label: extension

args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June.

Could you please let me know:
- Your availability for a group of 10 guests in June
- The room types and configurations that would suit a group of this size
- Group booking rates and any special offers
- Any deposit or payment requirements for group reservations

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
